name: AD4M (Coasys)
purpose: One open layer for identity, data and a group's shared spaces, where every agent, human or AI, runs its own node.
licence: CAL-1.0 (ad4m); flux without a stated licence

stack.credentials: none documented; every Expression is signed by its author
stack.transport: Holochain DHT per Neighbourhood; optional self-hosted link-server over HTTP and WebSocket
stack.trustTasks: none; pluggable Languages define how data is stored and shared
stack.groups: Neighbourhoods: app-independent shared graphs joined by URL, with access control in the Neighbourhood Expression (details not documented)
stack.devices: one executor per agent, on the device or a trusted host

trustTaskUse.note: Pluggable Languages define how data is stored and shared.

requiredParty: none by default (Holochain peers); an optional link-server

shared-room.note: Neighbourhoods are shared graphs synced by a link language.
